description: Non-material amendment to planning permission 24/04801 (Variation of condition 2 (Compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission PP/24/01524 to allow for the reduction in size of the internal lightwell at 1st, 2nd and 3rd floor levels to improve the internal layout of the residential units at those levels, and to ensure regulatory compliance with Building Regulations; by the acceptance of 16no. replacement drawings, and a minor change to the wording of condition 15 of the consent which erroneously refers to all windows being double hung sash windows.) to allow the addition of a roof access ladder to the rear elevation and the addition of a privacy screen to the fourth floor communal terrace, adjacent to No.50 Hans Place.
